subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Mina found her grandfather's old passport in a drawer.”?
options: In class, students discussed why creative work needs protection.
The passport showed another side: work, distance, and adaptation.
After that, players paid more attention to one another.
The diary showed history from inside one person's day.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「In class, students discussed why creative work needs protection.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The passport showed another side: work, distance, and adaptation.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「After that, players paid more attention to one another.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The diary showed history from inside one person's day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The passport showed another side: work, distance, and adaptation.」，答案為「The passport showed another side: work, distance, and adaptation.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The passport showed another side: work, distance, and adaptation.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
